# addressbook-query (RFC 6352 8.6): prop-filter FN/EMAIL/TEL with
# text-match (i;unicode-casemap, contains/equals/starts-with/ends-with,
# negate-condition), test anyof/allof, limit. Group vCards belong to the
# address book (iOS needs them).
@seed contacts kontakte erika.vcf erika.vcf
@seed contacts kontakte juergen.vcf juergen.vcf
@seed contacts kontakte familie.vcf group-family.vcf

# FN contains, without regard to case (ß/ü folded).
> REPORT /carddav/alex/addressbooks/kontakte/
> Auth: alex
> Depth: 1
>
> <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
> <C:addressbook-query xmlns:D="DAV:" xmlns:C="urn:ietf:params:xml:ns:carddav"><D:prop><D:getetag/><C:address-data><C:prop name="FN"/></C:address-data></D:prop><C:filter><C:prop-filter name="FN"><C:text-match collation="i;unicode-casemap" match-type="contains">JÜRGEN</C:text-match></C:prop-filter></C:filter></C:addressbook-query>
< status 207
< responses 1
< data /carddav/alex/addressbooks/kontakte/juergen.vcf juergen.vcf

# A property the server does not evaluate matches every card (the
# client filters).
> REPORT /carddav/alex/addressbooks/kontakte/
> Auth: alex
> Depth: 1
>
> <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
> <C:addressbook-query xmlns:D="DAV:" xmlns:C="urn:ietf:params:xml:ns:carddav"><D:prop><D:getetag/></D:prop><C:filter><C:prop-filter name="NICKNAME"><C:text-match>x</C:text-match></C:prop-filter></C:filter></C:addressbook-query>
< status 207
< responses 3

# limit: the first by name, then 507 for the address book.
> REPORT /carddav/alex/addressbooks/kontakte/
> Auth: alex
> Depth: 1
>
> <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
> <C:addressbook-query xmlns:D="DAV:" xmlns:C="urn:ietf:params:xml:ns:carddav"><D:prop><D:getetag/></D:prop><C:filter/><C:limit><C:nresults>2</C:nresults></C:limit></C:addressbook-query>
< status 207
< responses 3
< value /carddav/alex/addressbooks/kontakte/erika.vcf d:getetag {etag:erika.vcf}
< value /carddav/alex/addressbooks/kontakte/familie.vcf d:getetag {etag:group-family.vcf}
< response /carddav/alex/addressbooks/kontakte/ 507
< response-error /carddav/alex/addressbooks/kontakte/ d:number-of-matches-within-limits

> REPORT /carddav/alex/addressbooks/kontakte/
